stamps.name: Nyírjesi-erdészház
stamps.note: The MTSZ list gives the name, the replacing stamp (Vércverés) and the day, nothing else. The code is our own (the MTSZ code is not published online); the position (after Galyatető) follows a hikers' list of 2014 and the OKT forum, not an MTSZ publication, so the app says it is approximate. No coordinates: a retired stamp is never a map marker.
